name: Steinar
title: Charter Survey Lead
examine: Thirty years a surveyor, twelve for the Charter. The inn's best bed and a table for the chart. His stakes run in a ruled line across a kerb he has not walked out to see.
lines: The seam is there. The chain says so and the chain does not have opinions. Everything between here and it is the cost of getting there.
A kerb is stones. A concession is paper with a seal on it. I have never seen stones win that argument, and I have surveyed for thirty years.
Goblins. Lot nineteen. Yes, I know what they are doing on it. I am telling you what it is called.
